figurative_meaning_en: to slip out or be uttered inadvertently
similar_in_english: let the cat out of the bag
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মুখ থেকে রহস্যটি খসে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: The secret slipped from his mouth.
Once the words slip out, it's all over.
note: Refers to words or secrets unintentionally escaping from the mouth, common in everyday Bengali speech.
